Traffic/retry spike saturates market-data-service (and its redis path), inflating quote latency
auth-service v7.2.0 'SameSite=strict' cookie hardening (dep-5604) is the trigger

events.summary: The round-1 blocking gap — that the root hop (origin of MDS's cache-miss storm) was untested for all three hypotheses — is now closed. Redis-side has a directly observed discrete event: primary redis-cache-2 failed its health check at 13:22:10 and failover at 13:22:52 promoted an empty, mid-resync replica (F19), with the cache-wide read-side collapse confirmed by hit_ratio 95.9%->10.82% (F20/F34), connected_clients 304->40 and memory 70.5%->6.38% (F22), and flat evictions (F21) — i.e. instance loss, not eviction pressure. MDS's cache-miss storm (13:22:25, F10), CPU work-step to 90% with flat inbound request_rate (F31/F32), and error step (F33) all land in the same bucket; pricing-engine's deadline-exceeded on the market-data call (13:23:57, F9) follows. Critically, the two alternate origins are now contradicted by their own telemetry rather than assumed away: the external feed hop is flat (exchange-gateway p99 ~120-144ms, upstream_latency_ms ~117-123ms, upstream_error_rate ~0.30%, zero snapshot log entries — F25-F30), and load/retry is excluded by flat request_rate and flat pricing-engine CPU/memory (F31, F12, F32). The change set is cleanly excluded (only dep-5604 at 11:30Z, ~108 min early, wrong path; onset window empty with partial:false — F1/F2/F13/F14/F18). No surviving hypothesis names a different origin, so this is not inconclusive. Residuals that cap confidence rather than block: (1) redis metrics are 240s-bucketed so the ~15s lead of the 13:22:10 failover over the 13:22:25 miss storm rests on a single log line, and MDS p99 had already stepped in the 13:18 bucket before redis's earliest anomaly; (2) the root cause of redis-cache-2's PING timeouts (node death vs partition vs prior resync) is unexplained; (3) the write-vs-never-written distinction lacks a write_rate metric, though instance loss is mechanistically established by the observed empty-replica promotion and memory collapse. These justify a confidence cap, not further rounds.
